lead_headline: Restaurant tracker confirms five-day drought continues—zero new leads Friday as post-holiday freeze hardens into full week of silence

restaurant.blurb: Fifth consecutive day without new leads—detection silence extends through Friday as Memorial Day week closes with complete vacancy. Active pipeline remains frozen at 188 leads (106 openings, 82 closures).

liquor.blurb: Day 30: Month-long freeze reaches terminal day—Colorado's liquor licensing system completes unprecedented 30-day blackout as May closes with zero applications, zero status changes, zero administrative activity since April 30. All 12,396 tracked licenses remain locked in regulatory paralysis through month's final hours. The May freeze enters record books as longest documented suspension since tracking began—no restoration signals detected as June approaches with invisible backlog implications mounting. State officials maintain complete silence on timeline while the licensing apparatus sits dormant through entire calendar month.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions yesterday—citation flow bottoms out at minimal Friday volume as Memorial Day hangover completes full week of suppression. Week closes at 44 total mentions across 10 sources, down 29% from prior week's 62 as holiday lethargy persists. Instagram leads with 13 mentions (30%), Denver Post contributes 11, Facebook adds 8, Reddit delivers 5. Top recent pickups: Broncos' $45.8M Burnham Yard purchase agreement, Avalanche prospect coverage, Belleview Station residential opening. Google News RSS exclusively drives all discovery (100% weekly volume). The week-over-week decline confirms extended post-holiday drag on media pickup velocity, though monthly total holds elevated at 218 mentions as May concludes.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 yesterday (0 new, 1 canceled)—Memorial Day week closes with fifth consecutive day of zero-or-negative movement. MTD net advances to +31 (+1.1/day), 90-day net stands at +138. Seven-day window shows net +9 (15 new, 6 canceled) as May's final week salvages modest gains after mid-month drought. Recent fortnight reveals split pattern: May 16-25 delivered only +2 net across ten days, then May 26-29 surged with +7 in four days before yesterday's pullback. YTD pace of +1.3/day continues outperforming MTD rate as daily flow oscillates between zero-movement stretches and concentrated bursts. Month closes with momentum uncertain—brief late-May revival interrupted by Friday's negative print.
